subject.title: [Feature]: Support Slack Enterprise Grid org installs

question: Should OpenClaw accept explicit Slack Enterprise Grid org-install support as a built-in Slack channel mode, with unsupported detached delivery paths failing closed in the first version?
rationale: The request adds new Slack configuration and changes the Slack auth/session/delivery boundary, and the issue carries a maintainer label, so cleanup automation should not decide the product scope.

options.title: Review the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102372 to decide scope, compatibility, and proof requirements.

options.title: Narrow to an API seam
options.body: Ask for only the missing Slack/plugin API boundary if maintainers want Enterprise Grid behavior outside the bundled Slack plugin for now.

options.title: Reject core support
options.body: Close the cluster only if maintainers decide org-wide Slack installs are outside the built-in Slack channel roadmap.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102372 to decide scope, compatibility, and proof requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: Remote history shows the strongest recent ownership signal across Slack runtime, docs, and persistent state surfaces touched by the requested design.
